text:
devon: Quick heads-up — PR #26111 is blocked on CI. macOS ui-snap shard 7 failed with DashboardHeader.png diff. Need an approval but don't want to merge if it's flaky. Any quick ideas? :eyes:

marie: I reran it twice earlier. Run A passed, Run B failed with the same pixel row diff in header. Screenshot attached in buildkite — looks like subtle antialiasing change.

jonah: Can we do a targeted rerun for shard 7 only? If it's green twice I'll approve. Also worth checking if this matches the font-rendering flake we saw in #25980.

devon: yes planning a targeted rerun now. command I used: `bk rerun --build 8443 --scope=shard-7` — starting it.

ci-bot: buildkite: Triggered targeted rerun for build 8443 (shard-7). Rerun id: 8443.2

devon: Rerun 1 -> passed. Rerun 2 -> failed again. Same pixel row. :confused:

olivia: If it's nondeterministic across reruns we should avoid snapshot update. Could be font subpixel layout. I can take a quick bisect on the test if you want — have time this morning.

marie: agree — do a bisect between commits in the PR. If it's external (OS/font) we might need to pin the env or make the test tolerant.

jonah: I'll hold on approval. @devon please create an ephemeral job with `--record-artifact` and attach the diff image; olivia + I can look. If diff is intentional we can update snapshots but only after at least 2 consecutive green reruns.

devon: created artifact and started bisect: https://buildkite.com/r/redwood/builds/8443/artifacts/… will ping when I have a small repro. For now I'm not going to merge. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
